description: The file defines the AdminUserAPI class, which handles REST API requests (GET and POST) related to administrative user data during installation. It includes methods for creating and retrieving admin user info, utilizing external classes like UserCredential, StateContainer, and handling HTTP requests and responses.

classes.name: AdminUserAPI
classes.description: Handles REST API endpoints for creating and retrieving admin user data during installation process.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Processes POST requests to create an admin user, validating input data, and storing user info in StateContainer.

methods.name: checkAndGetField
methods.description: Validates presence and retrieves specific request fields, throws exception if missing.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve stored admin user data from StateContainer.
